captures.description: THE DATASET, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-01: 'The CoAuthor Dataset is a large-scale, process-oriented dataset capturing human-AI collaborative writing interactions developed by researchers Mina Lee, Percy Liang, and Qian Yang (CHI 2022).' Statistics (1,445 sessions; '63 qualified crowd workers from Amazon Mechanical Turk'; 830 stories by 58 writers, 615 essays by 49; 'Suggestion acceptance rate: 72.3%'; 'Human-authored text proportion: 72.6%'); keystroke-level logging; the Tab-key interface; davinci configurations; access (the Stanford site, GitHub, ACM, arXiv:2201.06796). Five cards: Stanford University, arXiv, ACM Digital Library, GitHub, alphaXiv.
